title: The Scout Camp | Nat 20 Pixels C1E5
description:
Firelight in the woods, goblin voices, and a cart that leaves at dawn.
The party is hurt, out of spells, and Tamsin has a plan that involves walking in alone.

Episode 5 of a daily pixel-art D&D 5e story. Brannoc, Ilsevel, Tamsin and Oriel follow the goblin trail to a scout camp deep in Thornpike Woods. A group stealth check, one very confident lie, and whatever is waiting in the cart. Every check and attack is decided by real, seeded dice shown on screen: no rerolls, no fudging.

New episode every weekday. Characters, quotes and every roll are on the wiki.
